en.description: A logo marquee: the list is duplicated and shifts by exactly half, so the seam between repeats never shows.

en.description: Reviews one at a time with arrow-key paging: the height holds to the longest one so the page never jumps.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-005-* variables. Client component: "use client". All the reviews sit in one grid cell, and the hidden ones get visibility: hidden — that way the height is measured by the longest one and does not jump. en.title: Shop Rail
en.description: A product rail where the next card peeks past the edge and the arrows go dim at the ends: a disabled arrow answers "nothing further" before the click.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-010-* variables. A client component ("use client") — the edge state is computed on scroll. The rail stays native scrolling with scroll-snap: finger and wheel work on their own. The arrow step equals the card width plus the gap, so the rail stops exactly on a card rather than halfway. The edge position is recomputed in the onScroll handler and once after mounting: the buttons are switched off with the disabled attribute rather than a style, so that they drop out of the tab order.

items.description: Отзывы листаются сами, но замирают от любого намёка на интерес: наведения, фокуса внутри блока и нажатия на паузу, а при prefers-reduced-motion не запускаются вовсе.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-carousel-011-*. Клиентский ("use client") — таймер живёт в useEffect и пересоздаётся на каждой смене отзыва. Пауза складывается из трёх источников: наведение и фокус ставят held, кнопка переключает playing. prefers-reduced-motion проверяется через matchMedia на монтировании и просто выключает показ: движение здесь действие, а не украшение, поэтому отменять его надо целиком. en.title: Auto Reviews
en.description: Reviews advance on their own but freeze at any sign of interest: hover, focus inside the block, or the pause button — and with prefers-reduced-motion they never start.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-011-* variables. A client component ("use client") — the timer lives in useEffect and is recreated on every review change. The pause is made up of three sources: hover and focus set held, and the button toggles playing. prefers-reduced-motion is checked through matchMedia on mount and simply switches the show off: motion here is an action rather than decoration, so it has to be cancelled entirely. The quote height is fixed with min-height so that the page does not jump on a change.

en.title: Counter Belts
en.description: Two logo belts running in opposite directions with dissolved edges: counter-motion reads as "the list is long" rather than "a carousel is moving".
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-012-* variables. Server component: no hooks, the motion is entirely a CSS animation. Each belt is duplicated in the markup and shifted by exactly half its width including the gap, so no seam between the repeats is visible; the copy is marked aria-hidden so that the list is not read twice. The edges are dissolved with mask-image. The animation freezes both on hover and on focus inside the block, and under prefers-reduced-motion the belts stop and turn into ordinary horizontal scrolling.

en.title: Centering Thumbs
en.description: A gallery with a thumbnail strip where the chosen thumb scrolls itself to the centre and arrow keys walk the frames.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-013-* variables. A client component ("use client") — the position is held by useState. There are usually more thumbnails than fit the width, so the selected one is brought to the centre by a scrollIntoView({block: "nearest", inline: "center"}) call: block: "nearest" keeps the browser from pulling the whole page. The thumbnails are real buttons labelled "Frame N", and the selected one is marked with aria-current and a border rather than brightness alone: dimming the neighbours is barely noticeable on a small screen.

items.title: Колода с якорями
items.description: Карусель без единой строки JS, но со стрелками: пара стрелок лежит внутри каждого слайда и ведёт на соседний якорь, поэтому текущая позиция компоненту не нужна.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-carousel-014-*. Серверный: хуков нет вообще. Прокрутку и остановку держит scroll-snap-type:x mandatory со scroll-snap-stop:always, поэтому лента не проскакивает через слайд. Стрелки — обычные ссылки на идентификаторы соседних слайдов: браузер сам доезжает до нужного, а «предыдущий» и «следующий» известны на рендере. Идентификаторы собираются из пропа idPrefix, чтобы два блока на одной странице не перебили якоря друг друга.

en.title: Anchor Deck
en.description: A carousel with arrows and no JS at all: each slide carries its own pair of arrows pointing at the neighbouring anchors, so the component never needs to know the current position.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-014-* variables. Server component: no hooks at all. Scrolling and stopping are held by scroll-snap-type: x mandatory with scroll-snap-stop: always, so the rail does not skip past a slide. The arrows are ordinary links to the ids of the neighbouring slides: the browser reaches the right one itself, and "previous" and "next" are known at render. The ids are built from the idPrefix prop so that two blocks on one page do not break each other's anchors.

items.name: carousel-015
items.title: Кадры с подписями
items.description: Карусель, где подпись равноправна кадру: figure с figcaption под снимком, а место под текст зарезервировано, чтобы блок не прыгал.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-carousel-015-*. Клиентский ("use client") — позицию держит useState. Разметка построена на figure/figcaption, поэтому подпись остаётся подписью и для скринридера, и для поисковика. Текст стоит под кадром на светлой подложке: поверх снимка он читается только на тёмной картинке. Высота подписи зафиксирована min-height по самой длинной — иначе кнопки под ней подпрыгивают на каждом переключении. Кадр помечен role="img" с подписью.

en.title: Captioned Frames
en.description: A carousel where the caption is equal to the frame: a figure with a figcaption below the shot and reserved space so the block never jumps.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-015-* variables. A client component ("use client") — the position is held by useState. The markup is built on figure/figcaption, so the caption stays a caption both for a screen reader and for a search engine. The text sits under the frame on a light surface: over a shot it is readable only on a dark image. The caption height is fixed with min-height to the longest one — otherwise the buttons below it jump on every switch. The frame is marked role="img" with a label.

items.description: Карусель со счётчиком вместо точек: «3 из 8» и полоса заполнения отвечают точнее ряда кружков, а стрелки гаснут на краях незацикленной ленты.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-carousel-016-*. Клиентский ("use client") — позицию держит useState. en.title: Slide Counter
en.description: A carousel with a counter instead of dots: "3 of 8" plus a progress bar answers more precisely than a row of circles, and the arrows dim at the ends of a non-looping deck.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, the palette in the local --vibeui-carousel-016-* variables. A client component ("use client") — the position is held by useState. The frames sit in a stack and change by fading: the rail has nowhere to travel, because the position is conveyed by a counter. The invisible frames are marked inert and aria-hidden, and their visibility is killed not only with opacity but with visibility — otherwise they stay click targets. The counter is announced through role="status", and the share covered goes into CSS in the --vibeui-carousel-016-progress variable.

items.name: carousel-017
items.title: Галерея с лайтбоксом
items.description: Лента миниатюр, по клику кадр открывается крупно поверх страницы: стрелки, счётчик «3 из 12», а ловушка фокуса и Escape достаются от нативного dialog.
items.docs: Клиентский компонент: номер открытого кадра лежит в useState, окно — нативный <dialog>, открываемый через showModal(). Один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-carousel-017-*. Кадры не картинки: каждый снимок описан тоном в градусах и рисуется градиентом через переменную --vibeui-carousel-017-hue, поэтому у item'а нет ни изображений, ни сетевых запросов. Модальный режим даёт ловушку фокуса, закрытие по Escape и затемнение фона бесплатно; правило html:has(dialog[open]:modal){overflow:hidden} добирает то, чего браузер не делает, — блокировку прокрутки страницы. Стрелки внутри окна листают по кругу, ArrowLeft и ArrowRight делают то же с клавиатуры, счётчик собирается из шаблона counter. Проп defaultOpen открывает окно немодально через show(): оно остаётся внутри блока и попадает в кадр витрины.

<Carousel017
  label="Съёмка маршрута"

/>
ai.summary: Галерея из ленты миниатюр и лайтбокса на нативном dialog: стрелки, счётчик кадров, кадры нарисованы градиентами. Один файл, ноль зависимостей.

en.title: Collage Grid
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-aspect-006-*. The grid and its 3:2 ratio live on an inner element, because the root is declared a container and a container query acts only on descendants. The first tile spans two columns and two rows; in a narrow column the grid reflows to two columns and three rows with a 3:4 proportion. The tile hue is set by a variable. The tile fill is built from that hue and reads in both themes; of the fixed colours only the border remains, and it follows the surrounding color-scheme through light-dark(). The collage has no background of its own.

en.title: Embed Frame
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-aspect-007-*. The frame holds 16:10 — the familiar proportion of a map and a slide. The iframe carries loading="lazy" and title: without a title a screen reader calls the embed simply "frame". The placeholder is drawn with a grid of two gradients and a pin marker, so an empty frame reads as a map. The theme comes from the surrounding color-scheme through light-dark(): the frame has no background by default, it sits on the page background and darkens with it, and the background prop turns the fill on.

items.name: aspect-008

items.description: Заглушка галереи: кадры занимают ровно то место, которое займут снимки, поэтому при загрузке страница не прыгает.

en.title: Gallery Skeleton
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-aspect-008-*. The grid lives on an inner element, because the root is declared a container. The ratio is set once in a variable and applied to every tile. The shimmer runs along a gradient with a per-tile delay: a simultaneous flash looks like the screen blinking. The container is declared role="status" with aria-busy. The theme comes from the surrounding color-scheme through light-dark(): the placeholder darkens together with the page, otherwise light tiles would burn through a dark layout.
